uniform_high_noise.description: Synthetic Erdos-Renyi camera-location recovery (n=100, p=0.5) under uniform random direction corruption with q=0.7 and sigma=0.2, the setting of Supplement Table 14. Scored on 40 fixed hidden instances; each registered solver is run by the evaluator on observations only.

median_location_error.description: Per-instance median camera error after L1 similarity alignment to ground truth (the paper's headline metric), averaged over instances; failed instances count at the error of the all-cameras-at-one-point output.

mean_location_error.description: Per-instance mean camera error after alignment, averaged over instances; catches methods that improve the median while leaving many cameras poor.

p90_location_error.description: Per-instance 90th-percentile camera error after alignment, averaged over instances; emphasises tail failures under heavy corruption.

uniform_high_noise._note: results hold the paper's Supplement Table 14 median errors (10 trials, the authors' implementation). The paper reports only the median; mean and p90 are this gym's additional scored metrics.

adversarial_high_noise.description: Synthetic Erdos-Renyi camera-location recovery (n=100, p=0.5) under cycle-consistent adversarial direction corruption with q=0.45 and sigma=0.2, the setting of Supplement Table 15. Scored on 40 fixed hidden instances; each registered solver is run by the evaluator on observations only.
